cards.leadIn: Do not call while waiting in sequence:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Navy Corpus Tower, <callsign>, ready for departure, Nueces Transition.

cards.note: The sources do not give the Nueces request phrase. Check with an instructor.

cards.title: Continue to the Crosstown Expressway
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Nueces Transition / East Arrivals & Departures/KCRP
instructions: Maintain 1,500' MSL · 200 KIAS to the Crosstown Expressway
Remain north of SPID; do not fly south of SPID before the Crosstown Expressway
At Point Sunrise, contact Cabaniss Tower (UHF CH 27) or Corpus Christi Tower as directed
Then comply with CRP Tower instructions for a straight-in or overhead (RWY 31/36 and 18/13)
If directed, or if weather precludes 1,500', a one-in/one-out procedure at 1,000' MSL may be used
cards.note: Handoff per the Manual, §2-9. Check with an instructor for the exact CRP Tower frequency.
cards.source: Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slides 58–61; Part 2, slides 119–121.
